coastline.geojson.limitations: Generalised historical coastline; not navigation, precise coastal distance or legal boundaries. Source checking date is not survey date.
coastline.geojson.transformation: Clip line segments to registered extent using Liang-Barsky; retain disconnected parts; round to six decimals. No inferred land polygon or operational boundaries.

exercise.json.limitations: Invented vessels, receipt times, outages and exercise area. No real AIS, clients, ports, security facilities or operational incidents.

notices.districts: Contains information from geoBoundaries / Pathways Data Pvt. Ltd. / lgdirectory.gov.in, made available under ODbL 1.0 https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/. This derived district database and association fields are offered under ODbL 1.0.
notices.states: DataMeet India community / Election Commission of India via geoBoundaries; CC BY 2.5 IN https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5/in/
notices.transformation: Coastal states selected by source ISO. Districts associated using an interior point and exact polygon containment; unmatched units retained in exclusion ledger. Coordinates and polygon topology are unmodified. District list includes inland districts within coastal states.
notices.vintage: ADM1 metadata reports 2011 but includes later administrative units; temporal currency is unverified. ADM2 metadata represents 2021 and advertises 736 units, while the pinned simplified file contains 735. No current official jurisdiction claim.

sites.json.license: Generator MIT; vertex coordinates from geoBoundaries state polygons, CC BY 2.5 IN
sites.json.limitations: Invented sites on generalised public geometry. Not real ports, harbours, landing centres, facilities or jurisdictions; a site may fall near a real place by coincidence. Not for navigation or operational planning.
